question.text: If the area of the region $\left\{(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y}): 1+\mathrm{x}^2 \leq \mathrm{y} \leq \min \{\mathrm{x}+7,11-3 \mathrm{x}\}\right\}$ is A , then 3 A is equal to

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & A=\int_{-2}^1\left(x+7-x^2-1\right) d x+\int_1^2\left(11+3 x-x^2-1\right) d x \\ & =\left[\frac{x^2}{2}+6 x-\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_{-2}^1+\left[10 x-\frac{3 x^2}{2}-\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_1^2 \\ & =\frac{50}{3} \Rightarrow 3 A=50 \quad \text { Option (1) }\end{aligned}$
